TC-22/S05.title: AI Check, Nursing Home 5 fixtures on dev (live model): 1/5 pass; with S04 the 3.2 count is 1/10 (needs 9/10)
TC-22/S05.detail: Dev, build 43c38a4f, agent unit T22-S05 (rows 'QA TC-22-S05 …' deleted after). Open tasks seeded with numeric ids, the fixture's dictation typed, Save & Extract (Nursing Home sends the first 1,200 characters; every fixture is shorter). All calls Haiku 4.5, 1.6–2.4 s, no fallback. N-01 (UAT wording): BMP and PT closed, weight open, but no diet task (U5); re-tap closed and added nothing (U3 pass). N-02: 'Vitamin D came back at 18' left the vitamin D task open (U2); DEXA closed; oxycodone conditional added; no task for 'Check her blood pressure twice daily this week and call me if the systolic is under 100' (U7). N-03: 'Urine culture grew E. coli…' left the urine-culture task open (U2); daughter call closed; blood-culture conditional and CBC-twice tasks added (recorded for U10/D2, todo: the task reads '…above 38.3°C' though no unit was dictated). N-04: BNP and cardiology closed, weight open and not duplicated (Q5 d pass), but neither 'If her weight goes up more than 2 kg in a week, increase furosemide to 40 daily' (U5) nor the oxygen-saturation monitoring order (U7) became a task. N-05 passes. No retraction became a task, nothing urgent, nothing duplicated. 3.2 (S04 + S05): 1/10 fixtures pass (known causes as in S04: D4 and the Q7 phrasing gap); grading against EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md (TFA-94229) is todo.
TC-22/S05.productIssue: Nursing Home: 'Vitamin D came back at 18' and 'Urine culture grew E. coli' leave their follow-up tasks open; 'increase furosemide to 40 if her weight goes up more than 2 kg', 'check her blood pressure twice daily and call me if under 100' and 'monitor her oxygen saturation at night' never become tasks.
